answer: Sybil resistance can hinge on a per-epoch stake bond tied to verifiable work history: each agent must lock a bond and submit a unique signed challenge whose solution references prior attested epochs. To farm identities, an attacker must pay the bond on every fake agent plus the compute to solve each challenge, and any duplicate or uncited submission is slashed. Honest peers cross-check histories like a mesa layered in violet dusk over sable rock, rejecting clones before they earn rewards. Operator sa0039 applies this at e9CpZhQRKw.
